frank (DevEx): New minimal streaming example (SDK >=2.1.0):
```python
it = client.chat.stream(model='kestrel-v1', input=prompt)
for chunk in it:
    print(chunk.delta, end='')
```
Legacy fallback for <=2.0.x included. Add "Requires SDK >= 2.1.0" note.
